english: Normally holds NVDA 50%, SPY 50%. If NVDA falls 5% or more since the last rebalance, cut it to half. If NVDA rises 5% or more, double its weight (up to the max). Stop-loss: if NVDA is 15% below its peak, sell it and stay out until it rises 5% in one period. If everything falls 5% or more at once, move the whole fund to cash (USDG). Weights are rebalanced to these targets; leftover goes to cash.
